text.text: The DartFire Edge Cannulated Screw System is a comprehensive forefoot and midfoot screw system delivered in a ready-for-surgery configuration. Don’t settle for what’s available. Stop dealing with SPD surprises and delays. Choose a universal, sterile-packaged system that fits your practice - a whole new routine driven by efficiency and personalization.

text_1778452694.text:
• Low profile, self-drilling and self-tapping, titanium alloy (Ti 6Al-4V) compression screws designed with flutes running the length of the thread for exceptional bite and reliable sharpness
  • Headed and Headless options from 2.0mm to 4.0mm
  • Short thread, Long Thread, Full Thread options
  • Sterile instrument pack with k-wires, cannulated drill, cannulated depthsink, driver, handle (AO connection)
  • 2.0mm and 2.7mm snap-off screws
  • Color-coded implant and instrument pack labeling for easy identification

text.text:
Trayless efficiency
 
  • All screws and instrument packs come individually packaged and pre-sterilized
  • Easy-open tabs
  • See-through windows
  • High visibility, color-coded labeling
  • 72% decreased footprint compared with existing packaging1
  • 82% reduction in OR footprint compared to reusable trays2 
  • Outer packaging layers are 100% recyclable

text_copy.text:
Simply sharp

  • A screw system reimagined, not reprocessed
  • One-time use feature allows screws and instruments to provide reliable sharpness for every case
  • Cutting flutes run the entire length of the thread, creating an exceptional bite

text.text:
Designed for your practice
 
  • As part of the Pulse Intelligent Delivery Platform, procedure mapping technology allows offered diameters and lengths of screws to be personalized to your usage
  • Always have what you need and nothing that you don’t
  • A universal screw offering with headed and headless options ranging from short, long, and full thread giving your practice one reliable system
